sections.value:
Proof can expire between components even when each check is individually valid. A proven-close exemption must compare the presented digest against the capability revoked in the write: a cached admission-time SeatId is not enough after T1 has rotated to T2. Stale proof still permits the public-facts close, but it must set the unproven reissue mark.

An independently owned commit must also own its post-commit capability-map resync and successful nonce accounting. Losing only the awaiting caller can otherwise leave an old digest accepted in memory or omit a committed nonce from the success counter. The older cancellation note covers the admission guard; inspect these completion effects too.

Random sibling identifiers must be independent. Publishing the holder nudge's id revealed a shared random part before later prime FYIs were held; each FYI now draws its own part. Metadata disclosure is enough even when message bodies are private. Likewise two fresh kernel reads of one PID do not necessarily describe one incarnation: check start/parent coherence before accepting a walk.

Current continuation supersedes the 19:02 pending-head status. Only reviewer/183b is held; its 1fbe947 round-2 request is answered BLOCK, output 26991b897fbb707f8c9fe9a982e750caf72a55be.
